title: Having + Past Participle
comment: Indicates one action was completed before another.

annotations.translated_text: Miután befejezte a házi feladatát, kiment játszani.
annotations.original_text: Having finished her homework, she went out to play.

translations.hu: Miután befejezte a házi feladatát, kiment játszani.
translations.fr: Après avoir fini ses devoirs, elle est sortie jouer.
translations.pt: Depois de terminar o dever de casa, ela saiu para brincar.
translations.ru: Закончив домашнее задание, она вышла поиграть.
translations.ar: بعد أن انتهت من واجباتها المدرسية، خرجت للعب.

annotations.translated_text: Miután beszéltek a menedzserrel, úgy döntöttek, hogy folytatják a projektet.
annotations.original_text: Having spoken to the manager, they decided to go ahead with the project.

translations.hu: Miután beszéltek a menedzserrel, úgy döntöttek, hogy folytatják a projektet.
translations.tr: Yöneticiyle görüştükten sonra projeye devam etme kararı aldılar.
translations.ru: Поговорив с менеджером, они решили продолжить проект.

annotations.translated_text: Mivel évek óta a városban élek, jól ismerem a környéket.
annotations.original_text: Having lived in the city for years, I know the area well.

translations.hu: Mivel évek óta a városban élek, jól ismerem a környéket.
translations.tr: Yıllardır şehirde yaşadığım için bölgeyi iyi biliyorum.
translations.fr: Habitant en ville depuis des années, je connais bien le quartier.
translations.ru: Прожив в городе много лет, я хорошо знаю этот район.
translations.ar: بعد أن عشت في المدينة لسنوات، أعرف المنطقة جيدًا.

annotations.translated_text: Az utasítások elolvasása után megkezdtük a bútorok összeszerelését.
annotations.original_text: Having read the instructions, we began assembling the furniture.

translations.hu: Az utasítások elolvasása után megkezdtük a bútorok összeszerelését.
translations.tr: Talimatları okuduktan sonra mobilyaları monte etmeye başladık.
translations.ru: Прочитав инструкцию, мы приступили к сборке мебели.
translations.ar: بعد قراءة التعليمات، بدأنا بتجميع الأثاث.

annotations.translated_text: A tanfolyam elvégzése után készen álltak a záróvizsgára.
annotations.original_text: Having completed the course, they were ready for the final exam.

translations.hu: A tanfolyam elvégzése után készen álltak a záróvizsgára.
translations.tr: Kursu tamamladıktan sonra final sınavına hazırdılar.
translations.ru: Завершив курс, они были готовы к итоговому экзамену.
translations.ar: وبعد الانتهاء من الدورة أصبحوا مستعدين للامتحان النهائي.

annotations.translated_text: A terv megbeszélése után megegyeztünk, hogy továbblépünk.
annotations.original_text: Having discussed the plan, we agreed to move forward.

translations.hu: A terv megbeszélése után megegyeztünk, hogy továbblépünk.
translations.tr: Planı tartıştıktan sonra, ilerlemeye karar verdik.
translations.ru: Обсудив план, мы согласились двигаться вперед.
translations.ar: وبعد مناقشة الخطة، اتفقنا على المضي قدمًا.

annotations.translated_text: Miután látta a filmet, ajánlotta barátainak.
annotations.original_text: Having seen the movie, she recommended it to her friends.

translations.hu: Miután látta a filmet, ajánlotta barátainak.
translations.tr: Filmi izledikten sonra arkadaşlarına tavsiye etti.
translations.ru: Посмотрев фильм, она порекомендовала его своим друзьям.
translations.ar: بعد أن شاهدت الفيلم أوصت به لأصدقائها.

annotations.translated_text: Mivel figyelmeztették őket a viharra, korán menedéket kerestek.
annotations.original_text: Having been warned about the storm, they took shelter early.

translations.hu: Mivel figyelmeztették őket a viharra, korán menedéket kerestek.
translations.tr: Fırtına konusunda uyarıldıkları için erkenden sığınağa girdiler.
translations.ru: Будучи предупрежденными о шторме, они рано нашли укрытие.
translations.ar: بعد أن تم تحذيرهم من العاصفة، لجأوا إلى المأوى في وقت مبكر.

annotations.translated_text: Miután bejárta Európát, sok történetet kellett megosztania.
annotations.original_text: Having traveled around Europe, he had many stories to share.

translations.hu: Miután bejárta Európát, sok történetet kellett megosztania.
translations.tr: Avrupa'yı dolaştığı için paylaşacak pek çok hikayesi vardı.
translations.ru: Путешествуя по Европе, он мог поделиться множеством историй.
translations.ar: بعد أن سافر حول أوروبا، كان لديه العديد من القصص ليشاركها.

title: Subject + considers + noun + adjective
comment: Used to express someone's opinion or judgment about something.

annotations.original_text: She considers the project challenging.

translations.ar: تعتبر المشروع تحديًا.

annotations.translated_text: Ekip bu görevi acil olarak değerlendiriyor.
annotations.original_text: The team considers this task urgent.

translations.tr: Ekip bu görevi acil olarak değerlendiriyor.
translations.my: အဖွဲ့သည် ဤတာဝန်ကို အရေးတကြီးလုပ်ရန် စဉ်းစားသည်။.
translations.ar: ويرى الفريق أن هذه المهمة ملحة.

annotations.original_text: He considers the new policy fair.
We consider the proposal innovative.

translations.my: အဆိုပြုချက်သည် ဆန်းသစ်သည်ဟု ကျွန်ုပ်တို့ ယူဆပါသည်။.

annotations.original_text: They consider the report accurate.

translations.my: အစီရင်ခံစာကို မှန်ကန်သည်ဟု ယူဆကြသည်။.
translations.ar: يعتبرون التقرير دقيقا.

annotations.original_text: The manager considers the deadline achievable.

translations.tr: Yönetici son tarihin ulaşılabilir olduğunu düşünür.
translations.es: El gerente considera que el plazo es alcanzable.

annotations.original_text: She considers the solution practical.

translations.my: ဖြေရှင်းနည်းကို လက်တွေ့ကျကျ တွေးသည်။.

annotations.original_text: The company considers customer satisfaction important.
He considers the training essential.

translations.ar: ويعتبر التدريب أمرا ضروريا.

annotations.original_text: She was reviewing the document at the time.
They were discussing the contract at the time.
He was presenting the report at the time.
I was working on the design at the time.
We were testing the software at the time.
The team was brainstorming ideas at the time.

translations.tr: Ekip o sırada fikirler üzerinde beyin fırtınası yapıyordu.

annotations.original_text: She was organizing the event at the time.
He was negotiating with the client at the time.
They were fixing the issue at the time.

translations.ar: لقد كانوا يقومون بإصلاح المشكلة في ذلك الوقت.

title: Subject + was + verb-ing + at the time
comment: Describes an ongoing action in the past during a specific moment.

annotations.original_text: She prefers coffee to tea.

translations.lb: Si drénkt léiwer Kaffi wéi Téi.

annotations.original_text: He prefers working from home to commuting.

translations.tr: Evden çalışmayı işe gidip gelmeye tercih ediyor.
translations.ru: Он предпочитает работать дома, а не ездить на работу.
translations.ar: يفضل العمل من المنزل على التنقل.

annotations.original_text: The manager prefers efficiency to speed.
They prefer quality to quantity.
I prefer face-to-face meetings to emails.

translations.tr: Yüz yüze görüşmeyi e-postaya tercih ederim.

annotations.original_text: We prefer collaboration to competition.

translations.ar: نحن نفضل التعاون على المنافسة.

annotations.original_text: She prefers flexibility to rigid schedules.

translations.tr: Katı programlar yerine esnekliği tercih ediyor.
translations.ar: إنها تفضل المرونة على الجداول الزمنية الصارمة.

annotations.original_text: The team prefers innovation to tradition.
He prefers hands-on experience to theoretical knowledge.

translations.tr: Teorik bilgi yerine uygulamalı deneyimi tercih ediyor.
translations.ar: يفضل الخبرة العملية على المعرفة النظرية.

title: Subject + prefers + noun + to + noun
comment: Expresses a preference between two things.

annotations.original_text: She is bound to succeed in this role.

translations.ru: Она обязательно добьется успеха в этой роли.
translations.ar: ومن المؤكد أنها ستنجح في هذا الدور.

annotations.original_text: They are bound to meet the deadline.
He is bound to make a good impression.

translations.ar: من المؤكد أنه سيترك انطباعًا جيدًا.

annotations.original_text: We are bound to face challenges in this project.
The company is bound to grow next year.
She is bound to receive a promotion.
The team is bound to win the contract.
He is bound to learn quickly on the job.
They are bound to resolve the issue soon.

title: Subject + Is/Are Bound To + Verb
comment: Indicates a high likelihood or certainty of something happening.

annotations.original_text: She is accountable to the manager for meeting deadlines.

translations.tr: Son teslim tarihlerine uymak konusunda yöneticiye karşı sorumludur.
translations.ar: وهي مسؤولة أمام المدير عن الالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية.

annotations.original_text: The team is accountable to the board for project success.

translations.ar: الفريق مسؤول أمام مجلس الإدارة عن نجاح المشروع.

annotations.original_text: He is accountable to the client for delivering quality work.
We are accountable to the company for maintaining standards.

translations.tr: Standartları korumak için şirkete karşı sorumluyuz.
translations.ar: نحن مسؤولون أمام الشركة عن الحفاظ على المعايير.

annotations.original_text: They are accountable to the supervisor for completing tasks on time.

translations.ar: إنهم مسؤولون أمام المشرف عن إكمال المهام في الوقت المحدد.

annotations.original_text: She is accountable to the director for overseeing the budget.

translations.ar: وهي مسؤولة أمام المدير عن الإشراف على الميزانية.

annotations.original_text: He is accountable to the HR department for employee wellbeing.

translations.ar: وهو مسؤول أمام قسم الموارد البشرية عن رفاهية الموظفين.

annotations.original_text: We are accountable to the stakeholders for project outcomes.
The leader is accountable to the team for guiding them effectively.

translations.ar: القائد مسؤول أمام الفريق عن توجيههم بشكل فعال.

title: Subject + is accountable + to + person/organization + for + noun/verb-ing
comment: Indicates responsibility or obligation towards someone or something.

annotations.original_text: She agreed with the manager on the new policy.

translations.ru: Она согласилась с менеджером по поводу новой политики.

annotations.original_text: They agreed with the client about the project scope.

translations.ru: Они согласовали с клиентом объем проекта.
translations.ar: لقد اتفقوا مع العميل على نطاق المشروع.

annotations.original_text: He agreed with his colleague on the meeting agenda.
We agreed with the vendor about the payment terms.

translations.ar: لقد اتفقنا مع البائع على شروط الدفع.

annotations.original_text: She agreed with the director on the strategy.
They agreed with the consultant about the implementation plan.

translations.ar: واتفقوا مع المستشار على خطة التنفيذ.

annotations.original_text: He agreed with the team on the project timeline.

translations.tr: Projenin zaman çizelgesi konusunda ekiple anlaştı.

annotations.original_text: We agreed with the partner on the collaboration terms.
She agreed with her boss about the promotion criteria.

translations.ar: اتفقت مع رئيسها بشأن معايير الترقية.

title: Subject + agreed + with + person + on/about + topic
comment: Used to express a consensus or mutual understanding between individuals.

annotations.original_text: He must study continuously to maintain his grades.

translations.tr: Notlarını koruyabilmek için sürekli çalışması gerekiyor.
translations.hi: उसे अपने ग्रेड बनाए रखने के लिए लगातार अध्ययन करना होगा.

annotations.original_text: She must practice continuously to maintain her skills.

translations.tr: Becerilerini korumak için sürekli pratik yapması gerekiyor.

annotations.original_text: They must communicate continuously to maintain team cohesion.

translations.ar: يجب عليهم التواصل بشكل مستمر للحفاظ على تماسك الفريق.

annotations.original_text: We must monitor continuously to maintain system security.
The team must innovate continuously to maintain a competitive edge.
She must update continuously to maintain accurate records.
He must exercise continuously to maintain his health.
They must train continuously to maintain their fitness.
We must evaluate continuously to maintain high standards.

title: Subject + must + verb + continuously to + maintain + condition
comment: Expresses a necessity to repeatedly perform an action to uphold a certain condition.

annotations.original_text: The project is progressing well; as a matter of fact, we are ahead of schedule.

translations.tr: Proje iyi ilerliyor; aslında programın önündeyiz.
translations.ar: المشروع يتقدم بشكل جيد، في الواقع نحن متقدمون على الجدول الزمني.

annotations.original_text: She is an excellent leader; as a matter of fact, her team is the most productive.
annotations.chunkList: as a matter of^an excellent leader

translations.ar: إنها قائدة ممتازة، وفي الواقع، فريقها هو الأكثر إنتاجية.

annotations.original_text: We completed the task on time; as a matter of fact, we finished early.
He is very knowledgeable; as a matter of fact, he often gives lectures on the subject.
annotations.chunkList: as a matter of^give — gave  — given

translations.tr: Çok bilgili; hatta bu konuda sık sık dersler veriyor.

annotations.original_text: The product is selling fast; as a matter of fact, it’s our best-seller.
annotations.chunkList: sell — sold  — sold^as a matter of^our best-seller

translations.ar: المنتج يباع بسرعة، في الواقع، إنه المنتج الأكثر مبيعًا لدينا.

annotations.original_text: They handled the issue efficiently; as a matter of fact, the client was impressed.
The training was successful; as a matter of fact, feedback was overwhelmingly positive.

translations.tr: Eğitim başarılıydı; aslında geri bildirimler son derece olumluydu.

annotations.original_text: She is very organized; as a matter of fact, she manages multiple projects at once.
We exceeded our targets; as a matter of fact, we set a new company record.
annotations.chunkList: as a matter of^set — set  — set^a new company record

title: Main Clause + ; + As a Matter of Fact, + Main Clause
comment: Connects two related statements, emphasizing the truth of the second statement.

annotations.original_text: She habitually checks her emails at 8 AM.

translations.tr: O e-postalarını her zamanki gibi sabah 8'de kontrol ediyor.
translations.ar: إنها عادة ما تتحقق من رسائل البريد الإلكتروني الخاصة بها في الساعة 8 صباحًا.

annotations.original_text: He habitually goes for a run at 6 AM.

translations.tr: O her zaman sabah 6'da koşuya çıkar.

annotations.original_text: They habitually start meetings at 9 AM.
We habitually review our goals at the beginning of the month.
She habitually leaves the office at 5 PM.
He habitually reads reports at the end of the day.
They habitually discuss progress at noon.
We habitually update the database at the close of business.
She habitually prepares for the next day at 10 PM.

title: Subject + habitually + verb + at + time
comment: Describes a repeated or regular action at a specific time.

annotations.original_text: He has seen the company grow over the last decade.
annotations.chunkList: see — saw  — seen^grow — grew  — grown^the last decade

translations.tr: Şirketin son on yılda büyüdüğünü gördü.

annotations.original_text: She has seen her team grow over the past year.
annotations.chunkList: see — saw  — seen^grow — grew  — grown^the past year

annotations.original_text: They have seen the project grow over the past few months.
annotations.chunkList: see — saw  — seen^grow — grew  — grown^the past few months

annotations.original_text: We have seen sales grow over the last quarter.
annotations.chunkList: see — saw  — seen^grow — grew  — grown^the last quarter

annotations.original_text: The manager has seen the department grow over several years.
He has seen his skills grow over his career.
She has seen her business grow over five years.
They have seen customer satisfaction grow over the past year.
annotations.chunkList: see — saw  — seen^grow — grew  — grown^the past year

annotations.original_text: We have seen our profits grow over the last fiscal year.
annotations.chunkList: see — saw  — seen^grow — grew  — grown^the last fiscal year

translations.ar: لقد شهدنا نمو أرباحنا خلال السنة المالية الماضية.

title: Subject + has seen + noun + grow over + time period
comment: Used to describe witnessing progress or development over time.

annotations.original_text: I’m grateful for your support.
I’m grateful for the opportunity to learn.

translations.ar: أنا ممتن لفرصة التعلم.

annotations.original_text: I’m grateful for your guidance.
I’m grateful for having such a great team.
annotations.chunkList: have — had  — had^such a great team

translations.ar: أنا ممتن لوجود مثل هذا الفريق الرائع.
translations.tr: Böyle harika bir ekibe sahip olduğum için minnettarım.

annotations.original_text: I’m grateful for the feedback.
I’m grateful for your understanding.
I’m grateful for this experience.
I’m grateful for the chance to contribute.

translations.tr: Katkıda bulunma şansına sahip olduğum için minnettarım.
translations.ar: أنا ممتن لفرصة المساهمة.

annotations.original_text: I’m grateful for the trust you’ve placed in me.

title: I’m grateful for + noun/verb-ing
comment: Expresses appreciation or thankfulness for something.
